name: Virtue Breaker -Toraware no Shakuyaku-
source:
-An Imprisonment & Pleasure Surrender AVG-

She the noble, invincible leader of a female army, was captured by a demonic queen,
and by other methods her army's might was dispossessed, and they became prisoners.
In captivity the women were sexually exploited by an inescapable procession of r*pists,
human and monster alike!!

Powerless captives, the women could not fight back when they wanted but...
gradually the lust that was secreted unto their bodies created a trance of deadened submission,
and a drunken pleasure with no abatement.
